hazards: Volcanic tuff-breccia rock is embedded with cobbles/knobs that can pop loose without warning.
Approach roads (NF-25/28/77) are rough gravel beyond the FR-76 junction and need a high-clearance vehicle.
No cell service on approach or at the crag.

road.name: NF-25/NF-28/NF-77 from Randle to Pinto Rock
road.status: From Randle, NF-25 is paved/maintained gravel for ~19 miles, then NF-28 and NF-77 become progressively rougher forest roads (NF-77 described as rough, drive slow) for the final few miles to the pullout at Pinto Rock.
road.driveNote: Roughly 2-2.5 hours from Seattle/Portland to Randle, then about 45 min-1 hour further up the forest road network.
